title: Listening Drill — Slow streets
description: Short academic talk. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Slow streets
sections.transcript:
PRESENTER: Today I'm describing a small study of traffic on residential roads. I want you to listen for how the researchers measured change, because the result is easy to overstate.

PRESENTER: Their work took place in a housing district with recently changed signs. Instead of relying on what local people remembered, they recorded vehicle speeds. They noticed fewer peaks. That observation would have been missed if the team had visited only at the end.

PRESENTER: The largest limitation was diverted traffic. The report is therefore a starting point. In a follow-up, the team would add neighbouring roads. A wider study could show whether the original pattern holds.
